title: Koutetsu Tenshi Kurumi Zero
justification: TVDB 80790 renumbered season 0: it now holds only Zero's three OVAs, episodes 1 Angel Force (2001-04-18), 2 Angel Smile (2001-05-16) and 3 Angel Heart (2001-06-20), AniDB 1-3 by title and date, so the rows to the gone episodes 5-7 go and the default lands. TMDB 34751 season 0 keeps the old layout, Encore at 1-4 and Angel Force, Angel Smile and Angel Heart at 5-7, so tmdboffset is 4; the rows named TVDB only, and TMDB placed Zero on Encore's episodes. The offset is stated as 0 so the season 0 placement is published.
